entry.title: How to set up your Garmin for your first HYROX
entry.summary: Garmin watches have no HYROX activity. Three ways to track your first HYROX on a Garmin, two free and one dedicated app, with what each gives you on race day and who it suits.

entry.title: How to use your Garmin on HYROX race day
entry.summary: Race day with ROXZONE on a Garmin, from the evening before to the saved result: where to press LAP, how the Roxzone is timed, how to race to your plan, and how to fix a late press afterwards.

entry.title: What pace to aim for in your first HYROX
entry.summary: How to choose a realistic goal time for your first HYROX, why an even pace beats a fast start, and how to split the goal across all eight runs, eight stations and the Roxzone with a race plan on your Garmin.
